The petitioners have been carrying out the lawful industrial activities in the industrial shed constructed over the sub-plots except sub-plot nos. 5 and 9.

It is further the case of the petitioners that, 137 workers earn their livelihood by working in the said factories and the livelihood of the petitioners also depends on the industrial activities in the industrial sheds.
